method: Production esbuild bundle; Canvas; five tables of three series of 2,000 points (30,000 points); 1000x600 CSS px; single: the five lines in one panel; dashboard: columns [2, 1] of rows [2, 1] and [1, 1] (four titled panels) with an inset over the first showing 400..600 with an indicator; mounts: createChart plus a synchronous render, 19 per page after the first; resizes: 40 synchronous renders alternating 900 and 1000 px wide; pointers: 120 pointer moves across the panels, each the event's synchronous time plus the chart's part of the next frame (from the frame's timestamp to a callback requested after the chart's); five fresh pages per shape, alternating; no competitor timings
